sources.title: ByteDance backend interview raw OCR source
Deterministic and randomized non-empty subset differential validation

claims.text: The preserved raw source says only '算法题,子集问题,但不包含空集', and the structured record preserves the same non-empty-subset boundary without specifying input uniqueness, value-level deduplication, output order, or size limits.

The candidate explicitly chooses position-based subset semantics while labeling duplicate-value and output-order behavior as implementation contract rather than source fact, so it does not silently invent an element-uniqueness requirement.

The exact candidate backtracking implementation matches an independent bitmask oracle on five deterministic cases and 2000 seeded randomized arrays of length 0..10, excludes the empty subset, and preserves position-based multiplicity for repeated values.
For ten independently selectable positions the implementation emits exactly 1023 non-empty subsets, confirming the stated 2^n-1 result-count boundary for the selected contract.
